nativeInstall.purpose: cold-start and resolver-first non-sensitive validation only

public.requiredBeforeUse: HTTP success plus immutable candidate provenance readback

procedure: Record pre-deploy public source/tree and artifact digest.
Deploy only the bound candidate through the named executor before expiry.
On failed provenance, boot, resolver, or callback fail-close readback, restore the bound target.
Read back restored public source/tree and artifact identity before closing the lease.

permittedNonSensitiveVerification: Open Pay without a blank top-level tab.
Verify separate YNX Wallet and MetaMask labels and logos through provider discovery only.
Verify resolver-first unavailable behavior and callback fail-close behavior.
Verify prompt-free refresh and passive accountsChanged, chainChanged, and disconnect handling only when an already-approved provider is present.
completionRule: This request is not a lease, deployment, artifact, install, wallet approval, callback, signature, transaction, or public-runtime completion claim.
